# GitVerse

> Check your GitHub achievements progress: every badge, your tier and how far to the next one, verified against GitHub's own data, no token needed.

GitVerse is a free, open-source GitHub achievement tracker with a web checker and a Go CLI (MIT). Use the web checker at https://mygitverse.vercel.app/check/ or install the CLI with `go install github.com/TheVicky1/GitVerse/cmd/gitverse@latest` and run `gitverse <username>`. The CLI can use the user's existing GitHub CLI login for private-repository-aware checks. The web checker supports public checks without sign-in and optional GitHub sign-in for private-repository checks; its OAuth token is used for one check and revoked immediately. No manually created personal access token is required. It knows 15 achievements (8 earnable, 2 disabled, 2 retired, 3 internal) and 6 profile highlights. Catalog last verified 2026-10-17. It is not affiliated with GitHub.

## When to use GitVerse

Reach for GitVerse when a user asks about GitHub profile achievements (the badges such as Pull Shark, Starstruck, Galaxy Brain or YOLO):

- "Which GitHub achievements do I (or @someone) have, and at what tier?"
- "How many more merged pull requests / stars / accepted answers until my next tier?"
- "How do I earn <achievement>, and can it still be earned?"
- "How many GitHub achievements are there?" or a full list with tier thresholds.

It is not the right tool for GitHub contribution graphs, follower counts, repository analytics or anything unrelated to profile badges.

## How an agent should call it

- **Catalog facts (no user):** fetch https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements.json (every achievement, tiers, kind, how to earn) or read a page below. Every page also answers `Accept: text/markdown` with Markdown.
- **One user's progress, in a shell:** `go install github.com/TheVicky1/GitVerse/cmd/gitverse@latest`, then `gitverse <username> --json`. It uses the user's existing `gh auth login`; without it, public data only.
- **One user's progress, no shell:** send the user to https://mygitverse.vercel.app/check/ or link https://mygitverse.vercel.app/result?u=<username> (public data, HTML).
- **Accuracy questions:** cite https://mygitverse.vercel.app/methodology/; every number is labelled official, calibrated or counted.

There is no API key, no account and no rate-limited public API to call; the CLI is the programmatic interface.

## Achievements

- [Pull Shark](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/pull-shark/): Open pull requests that get merged. Tiers: 2 · 16 · 128 · 1024. Earnable.
- [Starstruck](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/starstruck/): Create a repository that gets stars. Tiers: 16 · 128 · 512 · 4096. Earnable.
- [Pair Extraordinaire](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/pair-extraordinaire/): Coauthor commits on merged pull requests. Tiers: 1 · 10 · 24 · 48. Earnable.
- [Galaxy Brain](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/galaxy-brain/): Have discussion answers accepted. Tiers: 2 · 8 · 16 · 32. Earnable.
- [Quickdraw](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/quickdraw/): Close an issue or pull request within 5 minutes of opening it. Tiers: one tier. Earnable.
- [YOLO](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/yolo/): Merge a pull request without a review. Tiers: one tier. Earnable.
- [Public Sponsor](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/public-sponsor/): Sponsor someone publicly through GitHub Sponsors. Tiers: one tier. Earnable.
- [Finishing Touch](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/finishing-touch/): Get pull requests that improve GitHub's UI quality merged. Tiers: 1 · 4 · 16 · 32. Earnable.
- [Heart On Your Sleeve](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/heart-on-your-sleeve/): React to something on GitHub with a ❤️ emoji. Tiers: ? · 16 · 128 · ?. Disabled (tested, not earnable now).
- [Open Sourcerer](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/open-sourcerer/): Have pull requests merged in several public repositories. Tiers: ? · 8 · 16 · 64. Disabled (tested, not earnable now).
- [Arctic Code Vault Contributor](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/arctic-code-vault-contributor/): Code in a repository of the 2020 GitHub Archive Program. Tiers: one tier. Retired (no longer earnable).
- [Mars 2020 Contributor](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/mars-2020-contributor/): Code in a repository used by the Mars 2020 Helicopter Mission. Tiers: one tier. Retired (no longer earnable).
- [Proxima Pioneer](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/proxima-pioneer/): GitHub staff: contributed to the Proxima proof of concept. Tiers: one tier. Internal (GitHub staff only).
- [Proxima Staffshipper](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/proxima-staffshipper/): GitHub staff: shipped the Proxima staffship instance. Tiers: one tier. Internal (GitHub staff only).
- [Proxima Staffuser](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/proxima-staffuser/): GitHub staff: your team was onboarded to Proxima. Tiers: one tier. Internal (GitHub staff only).

## Docs

- [All GitHub achievements](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements/): the full list with tiers
- [How accurate is it](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/methodology/): data sources, calibration, known limits
- [Check a user](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/check/): the web checker
- [CLI usage and flags](https://github.com/TheVicky1/GitVerse.git#readme): `gitverse [username] [--json] [--all]`
- [Source code](https://github.com/TheVicky1/GitVerse.git)
- [About GitVerse](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/about/): a developer-first intelligence suite engineered to provide complete transparency into GitHub profile achievements
- [Privacy](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/privacy/): gitVerse collects no personal data, stores no passwords or tokens, and runs without a database

## Optional

- [achievements.json](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/achievements.json): the catalog as JSON
- [llms-full.txt](https://mygitverse.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): every page as plain text
